metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_alignment: (mean off-diagonal sampled item-embedding cosine + 1)/2; directional alignment only, not evidence of preference diversity or rank collapse. Padding excluded; ordered valid-pair count reported.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampled_margin: Independent training-only probe: positive minus one sampled unseen-negative score at each valid next-item position. Mean, interpolated p10, fraction <0, fraction <0.5, and valid count. Not held-out ranking quality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:rank: One plus the number of eligible candidates preceding target under score descending, item ID ascending. Sampled and catalog settings are distinct.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:margin: Target score minus mean score of fixed eligible negatives; null when no negatives exist. Catalog margin uses all eligible non-target items.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:rank_delta: Intervention rank minus baseline rank on identical candidates; positive is worse target rank.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:hit10_delta: Intervention indicator(rank<=10) minus baseline indicator; an in-sample target-ranking change, not host HR@10.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:margin_delta: Intervention margin minus baseline margin on fixed negatives; score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:top10_overlap: Intersection of baseline and intervention top-10 item sets divided by min(10, candidate_count), with deterministic item-ID tie breaks.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:matching: r=min(3,floor((n-1)/3)); recent newest 2r nonfinal positions, older earliest 2r, random all nonfinal. Enumerated recent/older subsets minimize frequency-tertile-count L1, then position lexicographic order. Random subset uniformly sampled within a feasible minimum-discrepancy tertile vector; vector ties lexicographic.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:frequency_tertiles: Category training occurrence counts, sorted ascending with item ID breaking ties, partitioned by min(2,floor(3*index/catalog_size)); labels 0/1/2. Unobserved catalog items have count zero.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:repacked: Delete selected prefix positions, compact survivors, restore original right-aligned padding; changes evidence and absolute positions.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:last_item_repacked: Separate one-item final-query deletion; not an equal-count recent/older comparison.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:position_preserving: Optional explicitly declared architecture hook: original position IDs retained, removed keys/values masked at every layer, removed query outputs suppressed, and residual history branches masked. Still changes context; not preference causality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:local_shuffle: Nonidentity permutation of last min(5,n-1) nonfinal occupied positions, preserving final item and multiset. Equal repeated items can leave item sequence unchanged. Availability uses earliest observed public training timestamp only, not true release dates; unverified when timestamps missing.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:target_in_prefix: Exact item repeat in truncated prefix; repeated targets remain eligible for this diagnostic and are reported separately. No ownership or demand interpretation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:available_category_macro_m: Equal-weight average of nonempty observed category means, with contributing categories listed. It is a four-category macro only when all four contribute; empty values are null.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:paired_user_bootstrap_95_p: 1000 user-within-category resamples of paired differences, averaging nonempty category means equally. Conditional on fitted models, fixed cases/candidates; excludes training/candidate variability and adaptive selection bias.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:recommendations: Exact chunked full-category top-10 excluding padding and complete original seen history, scoring each selected user's encoded history once. Chunk pruning and merging use score descending/item ID ascending. May return fewer than ten unseen items.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:candidate_ids: Target plus up to 99 unique category negatives sampled without replacement, excluding complete original training history. Auxiliary seed 42 does not replicate host candidate sampling.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:catalog: All category items except original training-history items other than target. Same exclusions for every intervention. Sampled/catalog ranks compare candidate settings of one model, not order agreement across models.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:direct_temporal_contrasts: Paired recent-minus-older and random-minus-older comparisons on the same users and fixed candidates, reported separately for repacked and supported position-preserving controls. Rank, hit10, and margin differences use older removal as reference; overlap compares the two intervention top-10 sets. Bootstrap resamples paired user contrasts directly. Frequency matching does not establish preference causality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:configuration: Diagnostic-only configuration, counts, missing controls, and declared future ablation. Independent RNG streams derive deterministically from seed 42; intervention stream uses seed 43. No training changes, validation selection, or hidden test access occurs here.
